paras: The Alpha-N Carbon CSL Trunk Lid / Boot is engineered specifically for the BMW M2 G87 2023+ and 2 Series G42 2021+, and is available in Australia through iilumolab. Developed and manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance, a brand with deep roots in BMW motorsport, this carbon fibre trunk lid takes direct inspiration from BMW's legendary CSL design language.

The integrated ducktail profile enhances the rear appearance of the vehicle while contributing to improved aerodynamic balance. The sculpted ducktail spoiler generates additional rear downforce at speed, eliminating the need for a separate trunk-mounted spoiler and creating a purposeful motorsport aesthetic.
hl: Manufactured in Germany by Alpha-N Performance
Pre-preg 2x2 twill carbon fibre, sourced from Italy
Significant weight reduction over the factory steel panel
Installs using factory mounting locations with original BMW hardware transferred across
ft: Alpha-N CSL Carbon Trunk Lid / Boot for BMW M2 G87 2023+ / 2 Series G42 2021+
